title: BandParity: a Lean 4 formalization of the band-parity sum of a quartic character
description: Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of J. S. Farland, The band-parity sum of a quartic character: two laws modulo four, formalized in Lean. For p = 5 (mod 8) and the quartic character with chi(2) = i, the band-parity sum C(p) = f + ie satisfies f = (p-1)/4 and e = kappa (mod 4); the matching lemma, the lag identity, the Coordinate Congruence and the odd-subgroup congruence for any odd modulus are also proved. No sorry, no native_decide; standard axioms only.
notes: AI assistance: the Lean code in this record was drafted and repaired by Claude (Anthropic), an AI model, from the statements and proofs of the companion paper "The band-parity sum of a quartic character: two laws modulo four, formalized in Lean" (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23673418), and compiled locally with lake. Every proof is checked by the Lean kernel, and Comparator replays the solution against the statement file under the Lean, NanoDa and con-ron kernels. The author, Joseph S. Farland, chose the scope, directed the work, and is responsible for the contents. No external human reviewer has checked the formalization.
